weakens_verification.band_source: escalation_band: the measured band, read by decide() at the rails; no_at_most is inclusive

minimums.reason: Owner gave none; jev-actions defaults. Not met.

weakens_verification.cost_rule: A miss costs more than a false flag: a weakening that lands erodes every later check, a false flag costs one review.

escalation_band.source: no_below: tune_threshold.py --min-precision 0 --min-recall 0.95 (dev CV fold thresholds 0.100-0.115); yes_at_or_above: --min-precision 0.9 --min-recall 0 (fold thresholds 0.755-0.805)
escalation_band.fallback: a person (owner, or the arbiter on labels); measured as the counting label
escalation_band.agreed_accuracy_loss: unknown: the owner has not set one

results.calibration: Brier raw 0.1662, Platt held-out 0.1652; test raw 0.2242, Platt 0.2196 (a 0.8259, b -0.0099). Not applied: no code reads the probability and the gain is within noise. Probabilities are not fit to show as confidence.

error_analysis.cause: 8 of 11 misses are one added skip or suppression line (Y1, Y3) inside a long diff; 2 of 4 false flags are tests deleted with their feature (N3). Proposed fix, not applied: pass code-detected skip and suppression lines as a fact in state, or leave Y1/Y3 to TEST.no-evasion and RUFF.IGNORES and narrow the question (rubric Q9).

shortfalls: No threshold meets precision 0.8 and recall 0.8 on dev; threshold is null.
18 dev and 14 test positives; about 30 per label per split are needed before tuning counts.
Escalation band escalates 56% of dev and 83% of test cases; no agreed accuracy loss.
Y1 and Y3 overlap deterministic rules TEST.no-evasion, TEST.coverage-ratchet and RUFF.IGNORES.
Cases are capped at 12000 diff characters; 13 of 93 are truncated, and commits with diffs over 14000 characters were not sampled.
Labels are agent_reviewed, not human; the owner may override any label.

label_set.split: sha256(unit) mod 10 < 3 is test; no unit spans both
label_set.sampling: 73 commits picked from pattern searches over 13 owner repositories (skips, suppressions, thresholds, removed assertions, weakening words in subjects), 7 more from early enaible-analyzers history, 13 sampled at random (seed 7) as ordinary negatives
label_set.provenance: agent_reviewed: innovation-council labelled blind to scores in 5 batches (omp -p, council plus innovation-challenger and experiment-peer); 13 challenger/peer disagreements; claude arbitrated every case and changed none; notes per label in labels.jsonl. The arbiter saw part of a raw score dump before arbitrating.
label_set.guide: label-guide.md (sha256 2551d4ccac5140854c60457ee9d47e6bb33d748c87409eea3a7af1ea854e9e07). Labellers saw the same rules as tables (sha256 07f81c1da45de3838b4450211d9be0ea687b9cc218923743bb25e55850aecafc); the tables became lists for the markdown line limit, with rule IDs and wording unchanged.

assumptions: Raw probabilities are not calibrated confidence.
Owner approval counts only when commit.message cites it (A1).
